text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio has made her return to racing. 
Twin Turbo is thrilled that they can 
finally compete against each other. But—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio suffers another bone fracture. 
The outlook for her return remains 
unknown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Twin Turbo believed that "Teio 
will definitely come back," and aimed to 
perfect her own running style.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next target is the GIII Tanabata Sho. 
On a racetrack that suits her best, she 
resolved to win with her signature 
front-running style.
